capabilities: Treat notes matching a tag, property, or folder as projects
Edit project status, icon, progress, and due date in a note bar
Create project and child project notes with two-sided parent/child links
Render project list, table, and board layouts in Obsidian Bases
Scaffold projects from a configurable path template and optional Markdown template
disambiguation: Manages one project per whole note (1 note = 1 project); it is not a task manager for individual to-dos inside notes.
extras: The manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff. Markdown files remain the source of truth; the plugin only adds convenience UI on top.
problem: Obsidian has no lightweight way to manage projects that live as ordinary Markdown notes with frontmatter, and Bases lack project-specific layouts and controls.
summary: Treats tagged notes as projects, managing status, progress, and relationships via frontmatter with Bases board, table, and list views.
